Reachable keeps the content of a declarative shadow root

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<div><template shadowrootmode="open"><p>shadow body</p></template><span>light body</span></div>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(hidden_content: 'Reachable'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
